hunks.baseline: Not even the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord, who had brought down two Black Ghosts thanks to what could only be called a stroke of heaven-sent luck.
hunks.sol: Not the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord, who had brought down two Black Ghosts thanks to what could only be called a stroke of heaven-sent luck.

hunks.baseline: Not even his two pathetic Senior Brothers, who had somehow gone somber and were now rushing to support their Junior Brother as he staggered, utterly spent.
hunks.sol: Not his two pathetic Senior Brothers, who had somehow gone somber and were rushing to support their Junior Brother as he staggered, utterly spent.

hunks.baseline: Not even the Disciples of the Zhongnan Sect and the Gansu Murim Alliance, still fighting their separate battles on the blood-soaked snow.
hunks.sol: Not the Disciples of the Zhongnan Sect or the Gansu Murim Alliance fighters, still fighting their separate battles on the blood-soaked snow.

hunks.baseline: Not even a father standing like a stone monument where his son had disappeared, or the Fire Dragon Pavilion members pouring every last bit of strength into chasing after their friend and leader, who had already raced far ahead.
hunks.sol: Not the father standing like a stone monument where his son had disappeared, or the Fire Dragon Pavilion members pouring every last bit of strength into chasing their friend and leader, who had already raced far ahead.

hunks.baseline: If the hellish brimstone fires recorded in old scriptures really existed, would they look like this?
hunks.sol: If the brimstone fires of hell recorded in old scriptures really existed, would they look like this?

hunks.baseline: A deafening roar that left their ears ringing poured down over everyone’s heads.
hunks.sol: A deafening roar poured down over everyone’s heads, leaving their ears ringing.

hunks.baseline: Following the thing as it fell from dizzying heights like a meteor, an unbearable heat scorched the sky.
hunks.sol: As the sphere fell from a dizzying height like a meteor, its terrible heat scorched the sky.

hunks.baseline: Groans rose from here and there.
hunks.sol: Groans rose across the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: They were seeing it with their own eyes, and still couldn’t believe it. Something beyond comprehension.
hunks.sol: They were seeing it with their own eyes, and still they couldn’t believe it. Something beyond comprehension.

hunks.baseline: No one except the one person who had desperately tried to stop the calamity, but failed in the end.
hunks.sol: No one except the person who had desperately tried to stop it, but failed in the end.

hunks.baseline: One of the most powerful wide-area spells a human could wield—and a calamity in its own right, capable of taking thousands of lives with a single cast.
hunks.sol: One of the most powerful wide-area spells a human could wield—a calamity in its own right, capable of taking thousands of lives with a single cast.

hunks.baseline: He knew its power better than anyone, and that was why he’d tried to stop it.
hunks.sol: He knew its power better than anyone. That was why he’d tried to stop it.

hunks.baseline: If he could bring someone down in exchange—if he could stop the calamity—that would have been a decent end. He could have told himself as much.
hunks.sol: If he could bring someone down in exchange—if he could stop the calamity—he could have told himself it was a decent end.

hunks.baseline: Right now, all Jin Taekyung could do was feel the weakness constricting his entire body and stare blankly as the calamity unfolded.
hunks.sol: Now all Jin Taekyung could do was feel the strength draining from his entire body and stare blankly as the calamity unfolded.

hunks.baseline: The One Annihilation he’d launched while it was still incomplete.
hunks.sol: The One Annihilation he’d launched before it was complete.

hunks.baseline: Because it was incomplete, it hadn’t shattered every defensive barrier. And because of that, Jin Taekyung had survived.
hunks.sol: Because it was incomplete, it hadn’t shattered every defensive barrier. Because of that, Jin Taekyung had survived.

hunks.baseline: But for someone who had been prepared to give up everything, this was misfortune.
hunks.sol: But to someone who had been prepared to give up everything, surviving this way was misfortune.

hunks.baseline: But he couldn’t give up. He didn’t want to give up everything here.
hunks.sol: But he couldn’t give up. He didn’t want to give up on everything here.

hunks.baseline: Gripping the spear shaft before it could slip from his grasp, he used it as a cane and hauled his unsteady body upright.
hunks.sol: Gripping the spear shaft before it could slip from his hand, he used it as a cane and hauled his unsteady body upright.

hunks.baseline: “—Run! Everyone, run!”
hunks.sol: “—Get out of the way! All of you!”

hunks.baseline: He heard the screams of those who finally understood that the calamity falling from the sky, painting it red, was real.
hunks.sol: He heard the screams of those who had finally realized that the calamity falling from the sky, painting it red, was real.

hunks.baseline: He heard, too, the terrible confusion and fear covering the battlefield below the hill—and, somehow out of place amid it all, a calm voice.
hunks.sol: He heard the panic sweeping the battlefield below the hill—and, utterly out of place amid it all, a calm voice.

hunks.baseline: At the Grand Mage’s utterly composed voice, blood trickled from between Jin Taekyung’s clenched lips.
hunks.sol: At the Grand Mage’s composed voice, blood trickled from between Jin Taekyung’s clenched lips.

hunks.baseline: She appeared beside him as if she’d teleported—or, rather, she’d used Blink, which was teleportation itself—and stopped less than a *jang* away.
hunks.sol: She appeared beside him as if she’d teleported—or, rather, she had used Blink, which was teleportation itself—and stopped less than a *jang* away.

hunks.baseline: But unlike his voice, his eyes weren’t on the Grand Mage.
hunks.sol: But his eyes weren’t on the Grand Mage.

hunks.baseline: He watched the hellfire as it crossed the blackened sky, as slow as its enormous size, and continued,
hunks.sol: He watched the hellfire cross the blackened sky, moving slowly for all its enormous size, and continued.

hunks.baseline: Because he knew that better than anyone, Jin Taekyung turned without hesitation and gripped White Flame in a reverse hold.
hunks.sol: He knew that better than anyone. Without hesitation, Jin Taekyung turned and gripped White Flame in a reverse hold.

hunks.baseline: He’d fought to protect one ally rather than bring down one formidable enemy—to protect tens of thousands of lives.
hunks.sol: He’d fought to protect an ally rather than bring down a formidable enemy. To protect tens of thousands of lives.

hunks.baseline: He made his body, ready to break at any moment, into a bow and set White Flame, his spear, against its string.
hunks.sol: He made his body, ready to break at any moment, into a bow and set White Flame against its string.

hunks.baseline: The acupoints damaged earlier by the excessive release of power burned even under the tiny amount of Scorching Yang Qi he could muster.
hunks.sol: The acupoints damaged by his earlier, excessive release of power burned even under the tiny amount of Scorching Yang Qi he could muster.

hunks.baseline: He swallowed the blood pooled in his mouth along with the molar that had cracked and finally broken apart.
hunks.sol: He swallowed the blood pooled in his mouth along with the pieces of a molar that had cracked and finally broken apart.

hunks.baseline: A faint, delicate energy clung to the spearhead, like a heat haze. It could no longer be called Force.
hunks.sol: Only a faint shimmer of energy clung to the spearhead, like a heat haze. It could no longer be called Force.

hunks.baseline: *Can I do this? Can I?*
hunks.sol: *Can I do this?*

hunks.baseline: No—or rather, anyone who saw this situation would give the same answer.
hunks.sol: Anyone who saw him now would give the same answer.

hunks.baseline: Nothing more than the desperation and hope of a man who wanted to do his best, right up to the end.
hunks.sol: Nothing more than the desperate struggle and wish of a man who wanted to do everything he could right up to the end.

hunks.baseline: He’d been enraged by cruel reality, resigned to it, and, for a time, despaired. But the young man had kept dreaming.
hunks.sol: He’d been enraged by cruel reality, resigned himself to it, and even despaired for a time. But the young man had kept dreaming.

hunks.baseline: The reason he could never give up, even if he was a moth flying toward a blazing flame, even if he was a firefly destined to vanish beneath the heat of the burning sun.
hunks.sol: The reason he could never give up, even if he was a moth flying toward a blazing flame, even if he was a firefly destined to vanish in the heat of the burning sun.

hunks.baseline: His trembling legs finally steadied and planted themselves in the ground like iron pillars.
hunks.sol: His legs had stopped trembling. They planted themselves on the ground like iron towers.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, his shoulder drew back. The spearhead aimed at the distant sky shot forward with his next powerful step.
hunks.sol: His shoulder drew all the way back. Then, with a powerful step forward, he sent the spearhead aimed at the distant sky flying.

hunks.baseline: Every bit of a person’s strength condensed, then burst forth.
hunks.sol: Every bit of strength one man possessed condensed, then burst forth.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, compressed air exploded outward.
hunks.sol: Compressed air exploded with it.

hunks.baseline: It covered more than a hundred *jang* of distance, shrinking until it became a single point. Jin Taekyung watched it with eyes growing dim.
hunks.sol: As it closed the distance of some hundred *jang* and shrank to a single point, Jin Taekyung watched it with eyes growing dim.

hunks.baseline: He was nowhere near strong enough, fast enough, or possessed of enough internal energy to stop the Hell Fire the Grand Mage had prepared.
hunks.sol: He had nowhere near enough strength, speed, or internal energy to stop the Hell Fire the Grand Mage had prepared.

hunks.baseline: And the enemy’s sneer—the one who’d brought all of this upon him.
hunks.sol: And the mockery of the enemy who had brought all of this upon him.

hunks.baseline: And in the midst of a reality she couldn’t begin to understand, the Grand Mage suddenly turned her head.
hunks.sol: In the midst of a reality she couldn’t begin to understand, the Grand Mage suddenly turned her head.

hunks.baseline: At last, she saw Jin Taekyung, forcing his unsteady body to hold together as he watched the unbelievable scene.
hunks.sol: At last, she saw Jin Taekyung struggling to hold his unsteady body upright as he watched the unbelievable sight.

hunks.baseline: She saw the faint smile on his lips, and those lips, caked with dried blood, moving.
hunks.sol: She saw the faint smile on his face, and his lips, caked with dried blood, moving.

hunks.baseline: “Me, too. And them.”
hunks.sol: “Not me. Not them.”

hunks.baseline: A brief remark.
hunks.sol: Just a few words.

hunks.baseline: But the Grand Mage felt something and whipped her head around. At the same time, she found the answer to the question she’d asked herself moments earlier.
hunks.sol: But something in them made the Grand Mage whip her head around. At the same time, she found the answer to the question she’d asked herself moments earlier.

hunks.baseline: Dazzling streaks of light shot up from the ground and rained down on the sphere of fire covering everyone’s heads.
hunks.sol: Dazzling streaks of light rose from the ground and poured into the sphere of fire looming over everyone’s heads.

hunks.baseline: The people who shared the same dream as that young man were there.
hunks.sol: There were others who shared that young man’s dream.
